Klasse LookSettings.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.LookSettings.Builder
Umschließende Klasse:
LookSettings
public static final class LookSettings.Builder extends Object
Builds LookSettings instances.

Not thread safe; build on one thread and share the immutable result.
